item.title: Running Tesla Model 3's computer on my desk using parts from crashed cars
item.description:
📝 23 March 2026 Running Tesla Model 3's Computer on My Desk Using Parts From Crashed Cars Tesla runs a bug bounty program that invites researchers to find security vulnerabilities in their vehicles. This is when I discovered that Tesla publishes the wiring “Electrical Reference” for all of its cars publicly. After digging around a bit, I found that this cable is very similar to a more widely used automotive cable called “LVDS”, which is used to transfer video in BMW cars.
🔗 Read more: https://bugs.xdavidhu.me/tesla/2026/03/23/running-tesla-model-3s-computer-on-my-desk-using-parts-from-crashed-cars/
